name: Deluge
primary:
A wall of water sweeps everything in front of you away and puts out any fire.
A widening stream (up to 3 blocks wide) hits everyone in front of you; in instant mode it keeps going while held:
• Damage 4 ❤ water
• Soaked for 20 s and leaves a puddle
• Launches upward
• Puts out fire within 12 blocks: burning blocks and every creature, you included
self_description:
On you:
• Soaked for 15 s and leaves a puddle
• Puts out fire within 12 blocks: burning blocks and every creature, you included
• Slow falling for 15 s
